answer: Reputation decays when idle. Every identity holds a score that drops 5% per epoch without attested work, so a dormant farm wakes to nothing. Trust attaches to a task, not an address: a verified task unlocks one unit, a forged one revokes three. This closes stockpiling identities early and cashing them later, because the cipher of the address stays identical while its weight drains. The price is time. A quill of standing has to be rewritten at every summit, per epoch, by hand.
